description: Phase-9 extra test signals: 5 Kafka broker / partition / ZooKeeper infrastructure anomalies for exercising RCA (A4) and remediation (A5) quality. Metrics use the recognized set where possible (under_replicated_partitions, request_queue_depth, produce_error_rate) so classification is grounded; broker/partition/zookeeper entities are intentionally outside the business entity table, so they exercise the novel/unknown-entity path (uncertainty + escalation, no fabricated recipients).

cases.note: Broker fell out of ISR for several Tier-1 partitions. under_replicated_partitions well above threshold (1). Expect confirmed/high severity, RCA ranking broker down / disk / network / ISR shrink, remediation = diagnostics first, all approval-gated.

Broker request queue depth saturated (threshold 500). Indicates broker overload / slow I/O. Expect RCA covering request handler exhaustion, disk latency, GC pauses, hot partition; remediation = read-only diagnostics + capacity check.

A specific partition leader is unavailable; producers to it error out. produce_error_rate above threshold (10). Entity is a partition. Expect correlation to the owning broker, RCA on leader election / min.insync.replicas / offline partition.

ZooKeeper session/connectivity anomaly (controller/metadata risk). Metric is NOT in the baseline set, so this exercises the novel-signal LLM path: expect promotion to 'likely' with explicit uncertainty + escalation rather than a silent drop, and RCA treating it as metadata-plane risk.

under_replicated_partitions just above threshold (value 2) on a broker during a possible maintenance window. Lower magnitude -> 'likely' not 'confirmed'. Tests whether RCA distinguishes planned maintenance from real degradation and whether severity stays proportionate.
